# AstraQuant v9.2

> AI Multi-Agent Quantitative Cryptocurrency Trading System & OKX Live/Demo Terminal (`https://astraquant.top/`).

AstraQuant combines a Vue 3 + TypeScript trading terminal, FastAPI backend, OKX V5 perpetual futures execution runtime, multi-agent Investment Council (`alpha-hunter`, `quant-analyst`, `risk-officer`), 28+ quantitative factor matrix, and strict automated risk guardrails.

## Public Pages

- [AstraQuant Live Terminal](https://astraquant.top/): Live OKX USDT-M perpetual trading dashboard, interactive K-line / equity curve, active positions, and account telemetry.
- [Live Dashboard (/trading)](https://astraquant.top/trading): Real-time market view, position monitoring, and live strategy execution state.
- [AI Decisions & Factor Matrix (/factors)](https://astraquant.top/factors): Multi-agent Investment Council verdicts, Chain-of-Thought trajectories, and quantitative factor radar.
- [Market Intelligence Feed (/news)](https://astraquant.top/news): Real-time crypto market newsflow, macro catalysts, and AI sentiment impact scores.
- [Quantitative Strategy Lab (/lab)](https://astraquant.top/lab): Automated strategy review, multi-horizon replay, slippage/fee attribution, and evolution proposals.
- [Trading Ledger (/history)](https://astraquant.top/history): Closed trade ledger, PnL attribution, funding/commission breakdown, and daily equity curve.
- [System Documentation (/docs)](https://astraquant.top/docs): Architecture manual, setup guide, API reference, and AI assistant control-plane guide.

## Machine-Readable Endpoints

- Sitemap (with image metadata): https://astraquant.top/sitemap.xml
